subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should explicit Telegram subagent `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")` create a new user-visible forum topic, bind only the current conversation, or expose an opt-in split between those behaviors?
rationale: Current main intentionally defaults Telegram to current-conversation binding, while the open candidate PR implements child forum topics and the open product issue asks to avoid user-visible subagent threads by default.

options.title: Default current, opt-in child topics
options.body: Keep the current default and define a maintainer-approved opt-in capability/config path before landing the child-topic PR.

options.title: Land child-topic behavior
options.body: Accept that explicit Telegram subagent thread spawns create child forum topics and require live Telegram proof plus upgrade/security review.

options.title: Reject child-topic behavior
options.body: Close the child-topic PR and keep Telegram subagent thread binding scoped to the current conversation.

recommendation.title: Default current, opt-in child topics
recommendation.body: Keep the current default and define a maintainer-approved opt-in capability/config path before landing the child-topic PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He owned the current core thread-binding refactor and is best positioned to decide whether Telegram should diverge from the current placement model.
